notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only source with detail is one county list entry (no build year, height or type recorded; owner marked 'Mn MFS?'). The 1948 note is filed under this entry, but the county list does not say the note refers to a tower at this exact spot. No build date, staffing, fire, or site description found; the story says so. The FFLA coordinates place the site about 47.56 N, 92.64 W. Not tried: a county-level history or a Mountain Iron local-history search, which the budget did not allow.
